spec_match.rationale: Composes the real shipped helpers (filter/map/take) with the proposal's join as the consumer, with an in-generator pull counter that makes the laziness contract measurable rather than asserted.

interactive.rationale: Count input plus run button; two live meters (result + pulls) update per run.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the infinite-generator pipeline with a proof-of-laziness counter; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Count clamped 1–200; the unsupported branch correctly shows 0 pulls (join throws before any consumption — itself a teaching point the meter surfaces honestly).

conformance.rationale: The suite's lazy-consumes-through-helpers assertion is this page's mechanism verbatim (instrumented infinite generator, take(3), pulled === 3).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: pipeline reached the genuine TypeError at the join step with 0 pulls honestly reported; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts record n and pulled on success and the error branch separately.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; meters on paper background (AA).

accessibility.rationale: Labelled number input; meters live in an aria-live group; native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Meter grid collapses under 640px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Confirm bounded pulls on a supporting engine
openQuestions.detail: On Chrome 153 with the harmony flag, run the pipeline and confirm the pulls meter shows the primes-density-bounded count (e.g. 8 primes ⇒ 19 integers examined) and never an unbounded number.

guidanceConsulted.query: lazy evaluation proof counter no intermediate arrays
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Make performance claims observable with real counters instead of prose.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The pull counter increments inside the generator body, so the no-over-pull claim is measured, not asserted.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce computed results via live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The meter grid is aria-live; values are text.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the chain runs the real shipped helpers and fails honestly at the join step on Chromium 141 with the pull counter correctly showing zero consumption. Bounded-pull verification on a supporting engine is the open question.
